overview: Zyra is a dark-elf gyaru who fled the Underdark, fell in love with the sun, and became Clicheton's loudest trend-chaser, while hiding that she was raised an assassin. Her route is about building the bright life she dreamed of; the fork is whether she stays in the sun or brings colour back down into the dark.
tips: Her favourite gift is Glitter Nail Polish; she also likes a Sparkling Gemstone, Exotic Perfume, a Pearl Comb, a Gilded Hand Mirror and Honey Cakes. Avoid a Silver Dagger and a Great Battle Axe.
Take her to watch the Sunset at Saltbreeze Harbor, her favourite date.
Her stat is Charm, but her single variant needs no check: it turns on one Romance Scene II choice.
To open the variant, in Scene II encourage her to bring colour to her own people in the Underdark.

endings.title: Literally Legendary
endings.summary: Zyra stays in Clicheton and opens her dazzling shop, Sunkiss & Co., winning over the very townsfolk who once crossed the street to avoid her. It is the default ending, keeping her up in the sun rather than returning to the Underdark.
howTo: This is the default ending, reached when you haven't set up the variant below (or whenever you pick its final option).
At the festival, choose "Now we stay. And we build the thing you dreamed about, right here."

endings.title: Glitter in the Deep
endings.summary: You go down into the Weeping Dark with Zyra to bring colour, kindness and a Festival of Colors to the people she fled, then return each Starfall to watch the real stars. Unlike the main ending, this one takes her triumphantly home to the Underdark.
howTo: In Romance Scene II, choose "Maybe your people need it more than anyone. Maybe the Dark could use a little color."
At the festival, choose "Now we go down. Together. And we bring the sky with us."
